SELECT
    s.s_name,
    n.n_name,
    SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_inventory_cost
FROM supplier s
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'AFRICA'
    AND p.p_brand = 'Brand#24'
GROUP BY s.s_name, n.n_name
ORDER BY total_inventory_cost DESC, s.s_name ASC
LIMIT 5

        WHEN total_quantity <= 5000 THEN '1000-5000'
        ELSE '5000+'
    END AS volume_bucket,

    JOIN orders ON lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey
    WHERE orders.o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT'

    GROUP BY l_suppkey
) AS supplier_totals

    WHEN total_quantity <= 5000 THEN '1000-5000'
    ELSE '5000+'
END

    FROM orders o
    JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
    JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey

  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.o_orderdate) AS order_month,
  SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o

    SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH' THEN o.o_totalprice ELSE 0 END) AS high_priority_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority != '2-HIGH' THEN o.o_totalprice ELSE 0 END) AS other_priority_revenue
FROM
    orders o
JOIN
    customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
WHERE
    o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'
GROUP BY
    c.c_mktsegment

    high_priority_revenue > 0
ORDER BY
    high_priority_revenue DESC,
    c_mktsegment ASC

WITH RankedSuppliers AS (
    SELECT
        n.n_name,
        s.s_name,
        SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount) * (1 + li.l_tax)) AS total_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS supplier_rank
    FROM lineitem li
    JOIN supplier s ON li.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    WHERE li.l_shipmode = 'MAIL'
      AND YEAR(li.l_shipdate) = 1997
    GROUP BY n.n_name, s.s_name
)
SELECT
    n_name,
    s_name,
    total_revenue,
    supplier_rank
FROM RankedSuppliers
WHERE supplier_rank <= 3
ORDER BY n_name ASC, supplier_rank ASC

SELECT 
    l.l_shipmode,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN l.l_extendedprice ELSE 0 END) AS returned_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag != 'R' THEN l.l_extendedprice ELSE 0 END) AS kept_revenue,
    COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
FROM lineitem l
JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#52'
    AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1994-01-01' AND DATE '1994-12-31'
GROUP BY l.l_shipmode
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY (returned_revenue + kept_revenue) DESC, l_shipmode ASC

    p.p_name,

    pa.avg_supplycost AS avg_supplycost
FROM supplier s
JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey

SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', l_shipdate) AS shipment_year_month,
    SUM(l_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue
FROM
    lineitem l
    JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
    JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE
    c.c_mktsegment = 'FURNITURE'
    AND p.p_type LIKE '%TIN%'
    AND l_shipdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY
    strftime('%Y-%m', l_shipdate)
ORDER BY
    shipment_year_month ASC
